defense_news.title: MBDA and German startup Atmos team up to study space-based strike weapons
defense_news.summary: Pan-European missile maker MBDA and German startup Atmos Space Cargo are teaming up to study deploying deep-strike weapons from Earth orbit using reentry vehicles.

defense_news.title: Japanese nuclear submarines are a bad idea for East China Sea security — for now
defense_news.summary: Washington must rein in Tokyo’s ambitions for nuclear submarines, even as it encourages Japan to further develop defensive capabilities, writes analyst Lyle Goldstein.

defense_news.title: US surges power projection to westernmost island chain as Russia, China loom
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Air Force is expanding its training on America's westernmost islands, where it can project power and monitor adversaries across the Pacific and the Arctic.
